notes:
- **Account changes apply instantly**: bonus tokens, plan upgrades, subscription changes and unlocks now show up within seconds while the app is open - no restart needed. The chat tells you exactly what changed.
- **Seasonal looks**: the app can follow MyCraftingAI's seasonal themes (Christmas, Halloween, Black Friday and more) with matching colours and a small badge in the title bar.
- **Offers in the app**: when a promotion is running, it appears in the title bar and in upgrade prompts - one click opens the plans page.
